title: Medicine or Veterinary Science?
subtitle: 學測風格對話：模擬考成績夠上醫學系，但她真正想念的是獸醫，該怎麼跟爸媽說？

sentences.en: I just got back my mock exam results, and honestly, I'm more confused than ever.
sentences.zh: 我剛拿到模擬考成績，老實說，我比以前更迷惘了。

highlights.note: 開場點出情緒：成績出來反而更迷惘，引出後面的煩惱。

examples.en: We have a mock exam every month.
examples.zh: 我們每個月都有模擬考。

examples.en: I'm confused about the instructions.
examples.zh: 我搞不懂這些說明。

grammar.explanation: 比較級 + than ever 表示「比以往任何時候都更…」。

examples.en: She is busier than ever.
examples.zh: 她比以往都忙。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 more confused than before ever。

sentences.en: Why? I heard you did really well, especially in English.
sentences.zh: 為什麼？我聽說你考得很好，尤其是英文。

examples.en: He did well on the math test.
examples.zh: 他數學考得很好。

examples.en: I love fruit, especially mangoes.
examples.zh: 我很愛水果，尤其是芒果。

sentences.en: That's the problem. My scores are high enough for the medical school my parents keep talking about.
sentences.zh: 問題就在這裡。我的分數夠上爸媽一直掛在嘴邊的醫學系。

highlights.text: high enough for the medical school
highlights.note: 衝突點：分數夠上醫學系，那是爸媽的期望。

examples.en: She got into medical school.
examples.zh: 她考上醫學系了。

grammar.explanation: 形容詞 + enough 表示「足夠…」，enough 要放在形容詞後面。

examples.en: The room is big enough for ten people.
examples.zh: 這個房間夠十個人用。

grammar.pitfall: 不要說 enough high，enough 修飾形容詞時放在後面。

connected.note: keep 的 p 不除阻，talking 的 -ing 常唸成 /ɪn/。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing that's not what you actually want.
sentences.zh: 我猜那不是你真正想要的吧。

examples.en: What do you actually think?
examples.zh: 你真正的想法是什麼？

grammar.explanation: what 引導名詞子句，意思是「你真正想要的東西」，在句中當補語。

examples.en: This is what I need.
examples.zh: 這就是我需要的。

grammar.pitfall: 名詞子句用直述語序：what you want，不是 what do you want。

sentences.en: Not really. I've been volunteering at the animal shelter since tenth grade, and what I'd love to study is veterinary science.
sentences.zh: 不算是。我從高一就在動物收容所當志工，我真正想念的是獸醫系。

highlights.text: what I'd love to study is veterinary science
highlights.note: 她真正的志向：獸醫。學測常問「女生想念什麼」。

examples.en: We adopted our cat from an animal shelter.
examples.zh: 我們的貓是從收容所領養的。

examples.en: He wants to study veterinary science.
examples.zh: 他想念獸醫系。

examples.en: I volunteer at the library on weekends.
examples.zh: 我週末在圖書館當志工。

grammar.quote: I've been volunteering at the animal shelter since tenth grade
grammar.explanation: 現在完成進行式 have been + V-ing + since，強調從過去一直持續到現在的動作。

examples.en: She has been learning piano since she was six.
examples.zh: 她從六歲就開始學鋼琴，一直到現在。

grammar.pitfall: 不要用現在進行式：I'm volunteering since tenth grade 是錯的。

chunks.text: I've been volunteering at the animal shelter
chunks.zh: 我一直在動物收容所當志工

chunks.text: and what I'd love to study

sentences.en: Have you told your parents that, or have you just been hinting at it?
sentences.zh: 你有跟爸媽說過嗎？還是只是一直在暗示？

examples.en: He hinted at a surprise.
examples.zh: 他暗示會有驚喜。

connected.note: told 的 d 和 your 連音，變成 /dʒ/ 的聲音。

sentences.en: Mostly hinting, I suppose, because I don't want them to think I'm throwing away a good opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我想大多是暗示吧，因為我不想讓他們覺得我在浪費一個好機會。

examples.en: Don't throw away this chance.
examples.zh: 別浪費這個機會。

examples.en: This job is a great opportunity.
examples.zh: 這份工作是很好的機會。

grammar.explanation: want + 受詞 + to + 原形動詞，表示「希望某人做某事」。

examples.en: My parents want me to study law.
examples.zh: 我爸媽希望我念法律。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 want that they think。

chunks.text: because I don't want them to think
chunks.zh: 因為我不想讓他們覺得

chunks.text: I'm throwing away a good opportunity.

sentences.en: But from what you've told me, you'd be giving up something that matters more to you.
sentences.zh: 但照你跟我說的，你放棄的會是對你更重要的東西。

highlights.text: something that matters more to you
highlights.note: 男生的觀點：真正重要的是她自己的興趣。

examples.en: Don't give up your dream.
examples.zh: 不要放棄你的夢想。

examples.en: Your health matters most.
examples.zh: 你的健康最重要。

connected.note: what 的 t 和 you 連在一起，變成 /tʃ/ 的聲音。

sentences.en: I know. I guess I'm worried they'll see it as a less respectable choice.
sentences.zh: 我知道。我想我是擔心他們會覺得那是比較不體面的選擇。

examples.en: He has a respectable job at a bank.
examples.zh: 他在銀行有份體面的工作。

examples.en: Many people see failure as a lesson.
examples.zh: 很多人把失敗當作一堂課。

sentences.en: Why don't you show them your learning portfolio? It's full of the work you've done at the shelter.
sentences.zh: 你何不給他們看你的學習歷程檔案？裡面全是你在收容所做的事。

highlights.note: 建議一：用學習歷程檔案證明自己的投入。

examples.en: I added my science project to my learning portfolio.
examples.zh: 我把科展作品放進學習歷程檔案。

examples.en: The box is full of old photos.
examples.zh: 盒子裡全是舊照片。

grammar.explanation: Why don't you + 原形動詞？不是真的問原因，而是提出建議：「你何不…」。

examples.en: Why don't you take a break?
examples.zh: 你何不休息一下？

grammar.pitfall: 回答時不要用 Because，可以說 Good idea 或 Maybe I will。

sentences.en: That's actually a good point. It would prove this isn't just a passing interest.
sentences.zh: 這倒是個好主意。那可以證明這不只是一時的興趣。

examples.en: Music was more than a passing interest for him.
examples.zh: 音樂對他來說不只是一時的興趣。

examples.en: The photos prove that he was there.
examples.zh: 這些照片證明他當時在場。

sentences.en: You could also invite them to the university open day next month, so they can talk to the professors themselves.
sentences.zh: 你也可以邀他們參加下個月的大學校系開放日，讓他們親自跟教授聊聊。

highlights.text: the university open day next month
highlights.note: 建議二：帶爸媽去開放日，聽教授怎麼說。

examples.en: We visited three schools on open day.
examples.zh: 開放日那天我們參觀了三所學校。

examples.en: The professor answered all our questions.
examples.zh: 教授回答了我們所有的問題。

grammar.quote: so they can talk to the professors themselves
grammar.explanation: so + 子句（常搭配 can）表示目的：「好讓他們可以…」。

examples.en: Speak louder so everyone can hear you.
examples.zh: 大聲一點，讓大家都聽得到。

grammar.pitfall: 表目的時子句裡常用 can／could，不要用 will。

chunks.text: to the university open day next month,
chunks.zh: 參加下個月的大學開放日，

chunks.text: so they can talk to the professors themselves.
chunks.zh: 讓他們親自跟教授聊聊。

sentences.en: Hearing it from experts might reassure them more than anything I could say.
sentences.zh: 由專家來說，可能比我說什麼都更能讓他們放心。

examples.en: The doctor reassured me that it wasn't serious.
examples.zh: 醫生要我放心，說沒什麼大礙。

examples.en: Experts say we should sleep more.
examples.zh: 專家說我們應該多睡一點。

grammar.explanation: 動名詞片語當主詞，表示「聽專家說這件事」，後面接單數動詞。

examples.en: Reading before bed helps me relax.
examples.zh: 睡前閱讀幫助我放鬆。

grammar.pitfall: 不要用原形動詞當主詞：Hear it from experts might... 是錯的。

sentences.en: Exactly. Just be honest with them, and give them a chance to understand.
sentences.zh: 沒錯。對他們誠實就好，也給他們一個理解的機會。

examples.en: You should be honest with your friends.
examples.zh: 你應該對朋友誠實。

examples.en: Please give me a chance to explain.
examples.zh: 請給我一個解釋的機會。
